mission: Pin the GitHub Actions jobs that install Playwright 1.58.0 chromium to ubuntu-24.04. ubuntu-latest is moving to Ubuntu 26.04, and Playwright 1.58.0 refuses chromium there (Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64), so staging-automerge skips delivery scope, verification and signed-out web smoke after merge, and ops-readonly web-smoke fails the same way. Temporary until Playwright supports Ubuntu 26. Playwright stays at 1.58.0.

impacts.reason: runs-on ubuntu-latest -> ubuntu-24.04 only on the jobs that run `playwright install --with-deps chromium`: CI staging-automerge, ops-readonly runbook (web-smoke installs chromium in that shared job), reusable staging-delivery deliver, and Verify staging merge verify. One-line comment marks the pin temporary until Playwright supports Ubuntu 26. No Playwright upgrade, no other job, step, secret or delivery logic change. No collector rollout, Railway deploy, migration or fleet edit. hold-for-owner: the owner merges by hand.

resources: GitHub Actions runners for staging-automerge, ops-readonly runbook, staging-delivery deliver, and Verify staging merge
impact.deployment_impact: Runner label only. No collector rollout, no Railway deployment, no RAW migration, no fleet change. Hand-merged (hold-for-owner).

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json. The four jobs return to ubuntu-latest.
recovery.trigger: A pinned job fails for a reason other than the Ubuntu 26 chromium install, or ubuntu-24.04 runners are unavailable.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: After the owner hand-merges, Verify staging merge installs chromium on ubuntu-24.04 and runs the signed-out web smoke. ops-readonly web-smoke uses the same pin.
